description:
Problem: line 48 of ~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf pins shared-agent-execution to catalog commit cb442602fe1ed5d85dab3dab8896284d44c67d9a, but apply was never run. The store receipt (~/.skill-sync-deployment/store/skills/skill-sync.receipt:22-25) and the live release still name cf81aaaf2ff97a73fa47d877eb39933ef3039472. tools/skill-sync preview -C ~/.skill-sync-deployment, run from the primary clone (vendored v1.0.0-rc1, same blob as develop), shows exactly 4 changes: store/skills/shared-agent-execution/SKILL.md, store/skills/shared-agent-execution/references/external-harnesses.md, store/skills/skill-sync.manifest and store/skills/skill-sync.receipt (re-verified 2026-10-25). cb442602 is on the catalog's origin/main and descends from cf81aaaf; the 5 commits between them change only those 2 skill files (36 insertions, 18 deletions: role routing and effort).

What agents load: ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills and ~/.agents/skills are symlinks to ~/.skill-sync-deployment/releases/cf81aaaf2ff97a73fa47d877eb39933ef3039472/store/skills. apply writes only store/skills. Agents see a change only after activation (snapshot the store into releases/<sha> and repoint the three symlinks), which the conf header and the catalog README's Activation section make a separate, explicitly approved step.

Template drift: the reviewed template deployment/global/skill-sync.conf on the catalog's origin/main lists shared-agent-execution under the 48be0487de361c0f12e0b5ac5bc84cf832da1dd0 block and has no separate block for it. The deployment conf has diverged from the template, against its own header rule (bump rev in the template through review, then re-apply). The catalog checkout also holds someone's uncommitted comment edit to that template.

Outcome: the store matches the deployment configuration (applied or reverted), and the owner's choices on activation and template reconciliation are recorded.

Decision gates (owner):
1. Apply at cb442602fe1ed5d85dab3dab8896284d44c67d9a, or revert line 48 to cf81aaaf2ff97a73fa47d877eb39933ef3039472 (the commit in the current receipt).
2. If applied: activate now (new release snapshot and repoint the three symlinks), or leave the live release serving.
3. Reconcile the reviewed template through a pull request to joeharris76/skill-sync-skills, or record that the deployment-only split pin is intentional.
Before any action, run tools/skill-sync check -C ~/.skill-sync-deployment. It must exit 3 and list exactly the 4 paths above; on any other path or exit code, stop and report.

Item guardrails: never hand-edit the store, manifest or receipt; change them only through tools/skill-sync apply. On the revert path edit only line 48 of the conf. No activation without gate 2 approval. No commit to any repository under this item without the owner's gate 3 authorization; leave the catalog checkout's uncommitted template edit alone. No changes to BenchBox's tracked .claude/skills mirror. The repository PR guardrails do not apply because this item makes no BenchBox commit.
